newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps cuts ITT Industries paper.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps cuts ITT Industries paper.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Tuesday it lowered its rating on ITT Industries Inc's commercial paper to D-Two from D-One-Minus.

Duff & Phelps said it is also monitoring the company's debt, rated Single-A-Minus, for a possible downgrade after ITT said it will acquire Goulds Pumps Inc for $37 a share or about $815 million in cash.
Duff & Phelps said it plans to review the rating before the expected close of the acquisition in June.
Duff & Phelps said ITT Industries will initially use commercial paper to finance the acquisition, along with the assumption of $119 million of Goulds' debt.
"The debt-financed acquisition will significantly increase Industries' financial leverage," Duff and Phelps said in a statement.
Favorably, Duff & Phelps said the acquistion will boost ITT's fluid technology products, which is the company's highest margin segment.

"Goulds Pumps should be a very good strategic fit, with both products and geographical or end-user distribution channels that highly complement Industries' current fluid technology business," the firm said in a statement.
"DCR currently expects Industries will remain a solidly investment grade credit," it said.
